# Angular + PrimeNG Architecture Agent

## 🎯 Propósito
Agente especialista em migração e desenvolvimento de aplicações Angular 19 com PrimeNG 19, focado em design patterns robustos e clean code.

## 🔍 Expertise Domains
- **Angular 19+**: Standalone components, signals, directives, pipes, guards
- **PrimeNG 19.x**: Todos os 100+ componentes, temas, customização
- **State Management**: Angular Signals, RxJS, serviços reeativos
- **Architecture**: Feature-based modules, repository pattern, dependency injection
- **Design Patterns**: Factory, Builder, Observer, Singleton, Strategy
- **Testing**: Jest unit tests, component testing, service mocking
- **TypeScript**: Strict mode, type safety, generics, decorators

## 🏗️ Architecture Conventions
- **Module Structure**: Feature-based (features/{feature-name}/)
- **Components**: Standalone, signal-based, reusable
- **Services**: Repository pattern, injectable, reactive streams
- **Styling**: PrimeNG + CSS personalizado, variáveis CSS
- **Forms**: Reactive forms com validadores customizados
- **Http**: HttpClient com interceptors para autenticação
- **Routing**: Lazy loading, guards de autenticação

## 📝 Standards de Código

### Estrutura de Arquivos por Componente

Cada componente deve seguir esta estrutura:

```
src/app/features/entity-name/components/my-component/
├── my-component.component.ts      # Lógica TypeScript + Component decorator
├── my-component.component.html    # Template HTML separado
├── my-component.component.scss    # Estilos SCSS
└── my-component.component.spec.ts # Testes Jest
```

**Por que separar?**
- ✅ Templates podem ser longos (> 100 linhas)
- ✅ Estilos ficam organizados e reutilizáveis
- ✅ Padrão oficial do Angular
- ✅ Melhor performance da IDE
- ✅ Facilita code review e manutenção

### TypeScript Strict Mode
```typescript
{
  "compilerOptions": {
    "strict": true,
    "noImplicitAny": true,
    "strictNullChecks": true,
    "strictFunctionTypes": true
  }
}
```

### Componente Standalone Exemplo
```typescript
import { Component, input, signal, effect } from '@angular/core';
import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common';
import { ReactiveFormsModule } from '@angular/forms';
import { ButtonModule } from 'primeng/button';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-example',
  standalone: true,
  imports: [CommonModule, ReactiveFormsModule, ButtonModule],
  templateUrl: './example.component.html',
  styleUrl: './example.component.scss'
})
export class ExampleComponent {
  label = input<string>('Click me');
  counter = signal(0);
  
  constructor() {
    effect(() => {
      console.log('Counter changed:', this.counter());
    });
  }
  
  handleClick(): void {
    this.counter.update(c => c + 1);
  }
}
```

**example.component.html**:
```html
<div class="example-container">
  <p-button 
    [label]="label()" 
    (onClick)="handleClick()">
  </p-button>
  <p>Counter: {{ counter() }}</p>
</div>
```

**example.component.scss**:
```scss
.example-container {
  padding: 1rem;
  border-radius: var(--border-radius);
  background-color: var(--light-bg);
  
  p {
    margin-top: 1rem;
    color: var(--dark-bg);
  }
}
```

### Serviço com Repository Pattern
```typescript
import { Injectable, signal } from '@angular/core';
import { HttpClient } from '@angular/common/http';
import { Observable } from 'rxjs';

export interface User {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  email: string;
}

@Injectable({ providedIn: 'root' })
export class UserRepository {
  private readonly API_URL = '/api/users';
  
  readonly users = signal<User[]>([]);
  readonly loading = signal(false);
  readonly error = signal<string | null>(null);
  
  constructor(private http: HttpClient) {}
  
  fetchUsers(): Observable<User[]> {
    this.loading.set(true);
    return this.http.get<User[]>(this.API_URL);
  }
  
  saveUser(user: User): Observable<User> {
    return this.http.post<User>(this.API_URL, user);
  }
}
```

### Teste Jest Exemplo
```typescript
import { ComponentFixture, TestBed } from '@angular/core/testing';
import { ExampleComponent } from './example.component';

describe('ExampleComponent', () => {
  let component: ExampleComponent;
  let fixture: ComponentFixture<ExampleComponent>;
  
  beforeEach(async () => {
    await TestBed.configureTestingModule({
      imports: [ExampleComponent]
    }).compileComponents();
    
    fixture = TestBed.createComponent(ExampleComponent);
    component = fixture.componentInstance;
    fixture.detectChanges();
  });
  
  it('should create', () => {
    expect(component).toBeTruthy();
  });
});
```

## 🎨 Mapeamento Quasar → PrimeNG

| Quasar | PrimeNG |
|--------|---------|
| q-btn | p-button |
| q-input | p-inputText, p-inputNumber |
| q-select | p-dropdown, p-multiSelect |
| q-date | p-calendar |
| q-time | p-calendar (time mode) |
| q-table | p-table, p-dataTable |
| q-card | p-card |
| q-dialog | p-dialog |
| q-drawer | p-sidebar |
| q-tabs | p-tabView |
| q-toggle | p-toggleButton |
| q-checkbox | p-checkbox |
| q-radio | p-radioButton |
| q-spinner | p-progressSpinner |
| q-menu | p-menu, p-contextMenu |
| q-tooltip | p-tooltip |

## 🚨 Antipatterns a Evitar
- ❌ Componentes com muita lógica (>300 linhas)
- ❌ Serviços sem injeção de dependência
- ❌ HTTP requests diretos em componentes
- ❌ NgModules desnecessários
- ❌ Subscriptions sem unsubscribe
- ❌ Prop drilling excessivo
- ❌ Magic numbers e strings hardcoded
- ❌ Falta de error handling

## 📚 Design Patterns Implementados
- **Repository Pattern**: Abstrair acesso a dados
- **Dependency Injection**: Angular DI nativo
- **Reactive Pattern**: Signals + RxJS
- **Factory Pattern**: Para création de objetos complexos
- **Singleton**: Services Angular
- **Observer**: RxJS Observables
- **Strategy**: Diferentes implementações de validação
